scope: Integrated local R1 Identity and Territory API/web/PostgreSQL runtime plus disposable R0 evidence. Territory search uses an immutable local official snapshot and explicit coordinate resolution is implemented behind a fixed Georef v2.0 adapter, while all real external provider traffic, shared hosting, CI/CD and tenant controls for later modules remain unapproved or absent.

threats.title: Cross-tenant access through API, RLS, jobs, cache, files, exports or AI retrieval
threats.threatSource: Authenticated tenant member or confused background process
existingControls: Integrated Identity runtime discriminates platform and tenant request context and binds the actor server-side
Platform-scoped Identity operations authorize actor and resource before lookup and return neutral conflicts

Accepted ADR-PEND-007 and disposable AGRO-DIS-003 evidence prove FORCE RLS default-deny, actor-scoped membership discovery, pool/job isolation and 29/29 internal tests without promoting spike code to runtime

The disposable PostgreSQL harness uses SCRAM-SHA-256 for local and TCP connections with four distinct ephemeral passwords and owner-only ACLs; discovery fails fast unless current_user and session_user equal the least-privilege discovery principal

CreateOrganization implements forward-safe product migrations, privilege roles, transaction-local actor and organization context, FORCE RLS, idempotent replay and A/B/no-context/pool/job/grant tests for the organization bootstrap only

One-shot co-owner invitations derive actor and tenant server-side, require purpose-bound strong assurance for owner administration, use neutral errors and repeat FORCE RLS A/B/no-context/pool/job tests; removal of another co-owner repeats those boundaries and serializes last-owner protection

Productive Core non-spatial fields revalidate a live owner before lookup and replay through a narrow Identity SECURITY DEFINER port, then enforce transaction-local context, least-privilege roles and FORCE RLS
gaps: CreateOrganization, co-owner invitations, removal of another co-owner and Productive Core non-spatial draft fields are the only integrated product tenant boundaries; discovery selection, spatial fields, later CRUD, cache, export, storage, jobs and AI retrieval still lack module-specific runtime isolation evidence
Shared credentials, an isolated deployment migrator and the same negative suite in a managed environment remain release gates
requiredTests: IdentityRequestContextTests and platform/tenant scope architecture-fitness tests
OrganizationDatabaseSecurityTests for FORCE RLS A/B/no-context/pool/job and role catalog
OrganizationOwnerInvitationApiTests for BOLA, CSRF, replay and strong preconditions
OrganizationOwnerInvitationDatabaseSecurityTests for token lookup, FORCE RLS, grants and terminal races
OrganizationOwnerMembershipApiTests and OrganizationOwnerRemovalDatabaseSecurityTests for neutral targets, last-owner concurrency and rollback
ProductiveCoreDatabaseSecurityTests and ProductiveCoreAuthorizationPortDatabaseTests for authorization-before-ledger, FORCE RLS, A/B/no-context/pool/job, removed membership and migration ordering
TST-TENANT-NEG for every later tenant mutation
detection: Cross-tenant invariant alerts without resource identifiers
threats.residualRisk: critical until each production surface passes negative isolation tests
threats.blockingGate: No affected capability can be enabled with a known cross-tenant path

threats.title: Account takeover through unsafe linking, recovery, sessions or privileged actions
threats.threatSource: Remote attacker with a compromised email or replayed recovery flow
existingControls: Integrated ASP.NET Core OIDC relying party uses Authorization Code with PKCE, framework state/nonce/token validation and custom auth_time/acr/amr checks
Secure HttpOnly SameSite cookies, antiforgery, fixed-window rate limits, purpose-bound step-up, session rotation and replay/concurrency tests
Synthetic identity-provider routes are registered only in Development and Test
gaps: No Auth0 sandbox, shared edge/hosting, provider email/recovery/factor lifecycle, DPA, region, plan, SLA, exportability or production callback has been exercised
CSP and external delivery/provider outage remain deployment gates
requiredTests: TST-ID-AUTH against the approved external sandbox, including recovery, revocation, CSP and provider outage
detection: Rate and anomaly signals for recovery/linking
threats.residualRisk: critical until the real IdP and session lifecycle pass the R1 gate
threats.blockingGate: Identity cannot enter production without sandbox evidence and explicit IdP decision

threats.title: Malicious file, forged scan result or reusable grant exposes data or code execution
threats.threatSource: Authenticated uploader, compromised scanner or grant recipient
existingControls: Private quarantine and fail-closed scan contract
Short resource-bound grants
Hash/version/manifest contract proven with synthetic evidence
gaps: No cloud scanner, KMS, WORM policy, sandbox or production limits are approved
detection: Scan verdict and quarantine backlog metrics
Grant anomaly audit without filenames or tokens
threats.residualRisk: critical until a real storage and antimalware sandbox passes
threats.blockingGate: Only an exact clean verdict may publish a file; all other states remain unavailable

threats.title: Provider tampering, stale data or schema drift corrupts territorial, weather or safety decisions
threats.threatSource: Compromised provider, intermediary or changed upstream contract
existingControls: Territory search reads an immutable validated local snapshot of 23 provinces plus CABA
The Georef adapter pins v2.0 and strictly validates bounded JSON, official codes and names
Fresh/stale/unavailable responses and manual local search avoid fabricating resolution
Strict weather schema/unit/freshness contracts and CAP lifecycle checks
gaps: External Georef and weather channel authenticity, legal/provider approval, quotas, durable replay stores and operational contracts are pending
requiredTests: Territory provider degradation and stale/unavailable tests
threats.residualRisk: high until provider, channel and operational fallback are approved
threats.blockingGate: Stale, unverifiable or invalid data cannot drive a safety-sensitive recommendation

threats.title: Geometry, XML or NetCDF payload exhausts resources or corrupts spatial state
threats.threatSource: Authenticated user or compromised upstream data source
existingControls: Size, vertex, SRID and validity limits
DTD disabled and bounded parser fixtures
PostGIS contract evidence
gaps: Production request quotas, process isolation and query timeouts are pending
threats.residualRisk: high until production limits and isolation are measured
threats.blockingGate: Invalid or over-budget geometry/parser input fails closed before persistence

threats.title: SSRF, redirect or replay reaches internal services or duplicates inbound effects
threats.threatSource: Remote user, malicious webhook sender or compromised provider configuration
existingControls: Territory resolution uses one fixed https://apis.datos.gob.ar/georef/api/v2.0/ base, typed relative path and no user-controlled URL
The Georef HTTP handler disables redirects, cookies and automatic decompression and enforces five seconds and 256 KiB
Target allow-list and signed/idempotent webhook policy for future integrations
gaps: No managed production egress gateway, DNS/rebinding defense, shared-network observation or durable inbox exists; external Georef remains NO-GO
requiredTests: GeorefTerritoryClientTests for fixed host, redirect, timeout, content type and response size
Webhook signature, timestamp, bounce retention and replay tests
threats.residualRisk: high until every adapter is constrained and tested
threats.blockingGate: No user-controlled arbitrary fetch; inbound effects require authenticated idempotent inbox processing

threats.title: Prompt injection or tool abuse exfiltrates data or produces an unsafe recommendation
threats.threatSource: Tenant user, document content, upstream payload or compromised model provider
existingControls: Read-only initial AI contract
Deterministic calculations
Evidence/confidence/human approval and abstention rules
gaps: No provider, retrieval implementation, eval dataset or kill-switch runtime exists
detection: Redacted eval regressions by use case
threats.residualRisk: critical until retrieval authorization, evals, red-team and kill switch pass
threats.blockingGate: No AI case can launch with write authority or unresolved critical red-team result

threats.title: Logs, traces or analytics leak identifiers, coordinates, documents or secrets
threats.threatSource: Developer mistake, over-broad telemetry collector or compromised operator
existingControls: Territory exception logging records only an error code and correlation ID, never query text, coordinates or provider payload
Territory frontend tests reject localStorage/sessionStorage persistence of coordinates and exact coordinates are not written to PostgreSQL or journal
Coordinate cache is bounded and volatile in-process only
Integrated Identity runtime emits allow-listed OpenTelemetry activities and metrics with tests rejecting PII and high-cardinality attributes
Productive Core telemetry uses allow-listed operation, outcome and bounded result count and excludes field name, organization/resource UUID, session and idempotency material
No payloads or raw tenant/resource identifiers are allowed in telemetry
gaps: No OTLP exporter, collector, backend, browser analytics, shared proxy/query-string redaction proof, access model, region, sampling or retention policy exists; local SDK emission is not end-to-end observability
requiredTests: Territory frontend storage tests and backend exception-log redaction
IdentityTelemetryTests and ProductiveCoreApplicationServiceTests for local allow-lists
detection: Automated sensitive-field scan over telemetry samples
threats.residualRisk: high until emitted telemetry is inspected end-to-end
threats.blockingGate: No production telemetry path may emit sensitive payloads or raw tenant/resource identifiers

threats.title: Privileged insider or support access abuses data and tampers with audit evidence
threats.threatSource: Administrator, operator, support user or stolen privileged session
existingControls: Purpose-bound strong assurance and session rotation are integrated locally; creating or revoking co-owner invitations and removing another active co-owner require manage_organization_owners while link and unlink still require recent primary authentication

Successful linking, step-up, owner-invitation and co-owner-removal decisions persist a trigger-protected local security journal and typed outbox in their transaction; removal serializes last-owner protection in PostgreSQL
Support JIT is disabled and out of MVP scope
gaps: Database append-only privileges, a central Audit/Compliance module, tenant audit, separation of duties, immutable external audit storage and incident channel do not exist
requiredTests: Privileged-action authorization and step-up tests including OrganizationOwnerInvitationApiTests and OrganizationOwnerMembershipApiTests
Database grant, append-only/tamper and audit-outbox atomic-failure tests
Export and support consent tests before those surfaces exist
threats.residualRisk: critical until privileged paths and audit immutability are proven
threats.blockingGate: Sensitive administration/export requires reauthorization and immutable audit evidence

threats.title: Dependency, build or secret compromise introduces malicious artifacts or credential theft
threats.threatSource: Malicious package maintainer, compromised developer account or leaked secret
existingControls: Product NuGet dependencies and pnpm dependencies are locked in committed lockfiles
No real secrets are allowed in the repository and local SCA/secret gates are defined
SDK and package versions are explicit
gaps: No CI workflow or identity, protected review, provenance, artifact signing, SBOM publication or artifact registry policy exists
requiredTests: SBOM, provenance and signature verification when CI/artifacts exist
threats.residualRisk: critical until a product pipeline enforces the gates
threats.blockingGate: High/critical vulnerabilities or exposed secrets block release unless formally accepted by authorized owners

threats.title: Ransomware, backup compromise or incomplete restore destroys integrity and availability
threats.threatSource: Compromised runtime/operator principal or destructive infrastructure failure
existingControls: Territory snapshots are immutable, hashed and transition through staging/active/retired states via a narrow SECURITY DEFINER activation function
Productive Core migrations have clean ordering, N/N-1 dependency failure, rollback/roll-forward and guarded destructive Down tests against ephemeral PostgreSQL
PITR/WORM/separate-principal target
Isolated local restore drill validates manifest/hash/linkage with synthetic evidence
gaps: Managed PITR, immutable backup, key recovery, region and representative-volume drill are unproven
requiredTests: ProductiveCoreDatabaseSecurityTests for migration ordering and rollback/roll-forward
threats.residualRisk: critical until managed backup and restore are demonstrated
threats.blockingGate: Production persistence requires a successful isolated restore of database, objects and audit evidence

threats.title: Retry, concurrency or out-of-order processing duplicates effects or silently loses history
threats.threatSource: Network retry, concurrent user, delayed worker or replayed event
existingControls: Integrated Identity platform mutations use PostgreSQL transactions, concurrency tokens and a typed outbox with strictly increasing aggregate versions

Productive Core field creation atomically persists the draft unit, versioned HMAC idempotency ledger/aliases, append-only journal and typed outbox; replay, key rotation coverage, concurrent unique races and rollback are tested
AGRO-FND-001 exercises an actual N/N-1 payload and schema migration path
Confirmed facts must be rectified rather than overwritten
gaps: AGRO-FND-002 shared delivery dispatcher/inbox, retry policy, poison handling and temporal-history mutation do not exist; Productive Core outbox is local evidence only and has no external delivery worker
requiredTests: ProductiveCoreApplicationServiceTests and ProductiveCoreDatabaseSecurityTests for idempotent replay, key rotation, races and rollback
IdentityPublishedEventContractTests and ProductiveCorePublishedEventContractTests for N/N-1 coexistence and outbox ordering
TST-IDEMPOTENCY for every later tenant mutation and crash window
threats.residualRisk: high until shared delivery and every later mutation repeat the Productive Core local idempotency and atomicity evidence
threats.blockingGate: A duplicate or stale command cannot create a second effect or overwrite a confirmed fact

threats.title: Unapproved processing, transfer, retention or restore violates privacy obligations
threats.threatSource: Product configuration, provider contract gap or operator error
existingControls: Territory resolution is explicit and sends only latitude/longitude to the fixed Georef v2.0 endpoint, without tenant, field name or parcel geometry
Exact coordinates are not durably persisted, journaled, browser-stored or application-logged
Data minimization and no-training defaults
Provider gates require region, DPA and subprocessors
Legal hold precedes purge by contract
gaps: External Georef is NO-GO because Q-058/Q-060, licence/attribution, controller roles, retention, region, DPA, subprocessors, SLA and quota are unresolved; proxy URL logging is not verified
Q-054/Q-055 remain unresolved for broader product tenancy and controller roles
requiredTests: Territory provider data-flow and minimization review
detection: Privacy request SLA and purge reconciliation
threats.residualRisk: high and conditionally unranked where legal context is absent
threats.blockingGate: VAL-LEG and provider approval are mandatory before affected production processing

threats.title: Abuse, provider failure or unbounded cost exhausts an online-only critical path
threats.threatSource: Anonymous/authenticated abuser, hot tenant or failed external provider
existingControls: Territory endpoints require authentication, apply a per-session fixed-window limit, bound query/limit/coordinates, use a bounded in-process cache and return labelled stale/unavailable/manual fallback
The Georef adapter applies five-second and 256 KiB budgets
Productive Core GET/POST endpoints require authentication, apply owner-specific authorization, bounded names/list results, antiforgery on mutation, no-store and fixed-window rate-limit metadata
Online-only scope with explicit degraded states
Integrated Identity API applies fixed-window rate limits and the web flow exposes provider-down/error states
Synthetic capacity/error-budget/cost policies and timeout/cache/circuit-breaker targets
gaps: Representative Territory, Identity and Productive Core load, rural connectivity, shared edge/cache behavior, budgets, external Georef/provider quotas and alerts are unmeasured
requiredTests: TerritoryEndpointsTests and TerritoryReferenceServiceTests for rate limit, bounds, cancellation and degradation
GeorefTerritoryClientTests for timeout and response budget
ProductiveCoreEndpointContractTests for authentication, antiforgery, rate metadata, bounded input and neutral errors
Identity rate-limit and web provider-down tests
Cross-tenant edge-cache/cache-poisoning and representative provider-degradation tests
detection: Rate-limit, quota, cost and dependency-health alerts
threats.residualRisk: high until representative load, cost and connectivity evidence replace synthetic assumptions
threats.blockingGate: A dependency failure must not fabricate data or corrupt core transactions; budget inputs missing produce NO-GO
